name: shopping-agent
description: Search a bounded audited Shopify registry with coverage diagnostics, then use Chrome only after complete zero-result coverage.

interface.shortDescription: Match products across audited Shopify stores.
interface.longDescription: FindCheap-Agent is a Codex Plugin Agent. v0.2.3 searches a 45-store technically audited Shopify Storefront registry once, applies availability, latency, relevance, variant, and condition gates, reports coverage, returns an intent-aware Top 3 using literal lowest-price or merchant-diverse ranking, and uses authorized Chrome only after complete API coverage returns zero products.
defaultPrompt: Shopify first. Call search_shopify_products exactly once: limit=3; selectionMode=MERCHANT_DIVERSE unless cheapest is explicit.
